parameters.name: AddPartitionNum
parameters.description:
The number of partitions that you want to add to the topic.

*   The value must be an integer that is greater than 0.
*   To reduce the risk of data skew, we recommend that you set the value to a multiple of 6.
*   The number of total partitions ranges from 1 to 360.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alikafka modify-partition-num --instance-id alikafka_post-cn-0pp1l9z0000 --topic TopicPartitionNum --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --add-partition-num 6 --api-version 2019-09-16 --region cn-hangzhou
